description: Which funds held a stock on one date (SEC Form N-PORT, point in time: each fund's newest portfolio filed by the date), largest positions first, plus the tracked indexes it belonged to (index_memberships) and totals over every holder (fund_count, fund_shares). Each fund's shares and value_usd are as of its own report_date, typically 2-5 months earlier. Costs 1 credit plus 1 per 100 funds beyond 100.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD (default today). History depth depends on plan.

etf_only.description: true: only ETFs listed in TickerDB.

ticker.description: Stock or ETF ticker, e.g. "AAPL" (former symbols resolve).

name: get_fund_holders

data.description: The TickerDB API response payload for this tool call.
